mission.summary: GuiAgentLoopCore provides the core logic for bridging GUI frameworks and LLM agents, managing conversation flow, agent interactions, and state control.

core_value.summary: Reliable, type-safe, and extensible foundation for GUI-LLM integration with predictable state management and clear component boundaries.

functions.name: Centralized Conversation Management
functions.details: Interpreter component centralizes conversation flow, state management, and agent coordination

functions.name: State Machine with Monotonic Transitions
functions.details: Enforce monotonic state transitions (INIT → RUNNING → STOP) through hard invariants

functions.name: Multi-Agent Coordination
functions.details: Role-based agent system (AGENT_EXECUTOR, LLM_PLANNER, SUPERVISOR, etc.) with clear boundaries

functions.name: Structured Message Processing
functions.details: Handle structured communication between users, systems, and agents

functions.name: Backend Abstraction
functions.details: Enable multiple GUI framework implementations (Gradio, extensible to others)
